description: Build Django 6.1.1/PostgreSQL applications with professional admin, iterative accessible UX, local/DevTest/UAT/production, OIDC and measured scaling.

requires.python: >=3.10 standard library for checker; compatible Python 3.14 patch preferred for applications
requires.application: Git, uv, PostgreSQL >=15 (supported 18 patch preferred), psycopg 3; exact project dependencies must be verified and locked
requires.model: Operator-configured Ask model and credentials; none bundled
requires.review: Independent PostgreSQL/auth/admin tests, browser/user review and live IdP/operations acceptance; checker validates only bound artifacts
